messages:
mike-ml: Proposal — 'precision watermarks' for staged low-bit rollouts. We track quality metrics (per-endpoint accuracy / hallucination rate / user-drop) and only expand lowbit cohorts when their watermark is met. Start tiny (0.5% traffic) -> 2% -> 10%. Anyone see obvious gaps? :thinking:

anya-api: I like the concept. Need to decide the sampling signals and the evaluation window. Suggest paired A/B on a golden prompt set + live sampling of end-to-end intent agreement. What stat test are we using? binomial for error rates? :thinking:

lucas-runtime: From runtime side we need per-request metadata tags: `precision_level`, `cohort_id`, `profile_version`. Also watch out for KV-cache compatibility — if lowbit packing changes cache keys/shape we must avoid cross-cohort cache contamination.

sara-ops: Ops checklist: automated rollback when watermark drops, alerting for delta > 0.5% on key quality metrics, and a manual hold for enterprise customers. Also capture cost delta so product can weigh tradeoffs. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

mike-ml: +1 on tags and cost telemetry. For stats I'm leaning sequential testing (alpha spending) so we can stop early. QA will own the golden prompt set. Example rollout config (draft):
```json
{"stages": [{"size_pct":0.5, "min_samples":1000, "watermark_quality":0.995}, {"size_pct":2.0, "min_samples":5000, "watermark_quality":0.993}, {"size_pct":10.0, "min_samples":20000, "watermark_quality":0.990}], "metrics": ["intent_agreement", "halluc_rate", "latency_p95"], "stratify_by": ["endpoint", "customer_tier"]}
```

anya-api: Also need to account for long-tail prompts. Recommend stratified sampling by endpoint + user segment and reserve a small adversarial holdout set for regression detection.

lucas-runtime: Runtime addendum: ensure warmup behavior for lowbit weight packing. First N requests for a newly promoted cohort should bypass lowbit path until KV/cache warm state is achieved, otherwise we see cold-latency spikes and noisy quality signals.

sara-ops: Could we dark-launch this for 2 weeks (mirror traffic and compute the metrics without switching responses) to validate the watermark thresholds? Cheaper and safer to catch regressions before user exposure.

rollout-bot: Plan created: `precision-watermarks/v1` started by @mike-ml. Stage 0.5% -> monitor 14d -> expand on pass. Assigned watchers: @anya-api, @lucas-runtime, @sara-ops. RFC link: https://redwood.internal/rfc/precision-watermarks :eyes:

mike-ml: Thanks — I'll flesh the RFC with the config schema, sequential test plan, and an ops rollback playbook. Please add any missing must-have telemetry or gate conditions in the RFC comments.
